name: Hero

images.credit: Creative Tools. Watermark removed by User:Ainali, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: HTC Evo Design 4G, HTC Legend, HTC Desire

Network.Technology: GSM version: quad band GSM 850/900/1800/1900 MHz GPRS/EDGE, and, dual band UMTS 900/2100 MHz HSPA (Europe), or, dual band UMTS 850/1900 MHz HSPA (North America), CDMA version: dual band CDMA2000/EV-DO Rev. A 800/1900 MHz

Platform.Operating system: Android 1.5 Cupcake, upgradable to Android 2.1 Eclair with HTC Sense UI
Platform.CPU: 528 MHz Qualcomm MSM7600A or MSM7200A ARM11 processor

Display.Display: 320 × 480 px, 3.2 in, HVGA, 65,536 color LCD at 180 pixels per inch (ppi)

Battery.Battery: GSM version: 3.7 V 1340 mAh, CDMA version: 3.7 V 1500 mAh, Internal rechargeable removable lithium-ion battery
